sub: A Rust runtime vs Docker Desktop
scenes.say: Docker run, in two point five milliseconds? Meet Kiri, a container runtime written in Rust.

scenes.heading: Container start time
scenes.say: In the author's own benchmark, it starts a throwaway Alpine container in 2.55 milliseconds. Docker Desktop took 213.

scenes.heading: Same Docker workflow
scenes.label: docker compose up
scenes.caption: Docker CLI + Compose ✓
scenes.say: And you keep your workflow. It speaks the Docker Engine API, so the Docker CLI and Compose just work.

scenes.heading: How it runs
scenes.say: On Mac and Windows, Kiri runs your containers inside a lightweight Linux VM. On Linux, straight on the kernel.

scenes.heading: Try it
question: Would you switch?
scenes.say: It's brand new, so try it at github dot com slash libracoder slash kiri. Would you switch?
